'''Bastiaan Proot''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 92 from Gent, Bel. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"I'm 24 and a student in Computer Sciences at the University of Ghent, in Belgium."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/proot.html Bastiaan Proot], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428040602/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/proot.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"My hobbies are playing games, listening to music, watching television, eating and sleeping."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite scene from Star Wars is when the Millennium Falcon shoots out of the Death Star, just in time."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My favorite Star Wars line is, 'The Emperor is not as forgiving as I am."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"At last year's world-qualifying tournaments, I finished second to Maarten Logghe in Antwerp, and third to Stefaan Destoop, my other Star Wars CCG playing friend, in London."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I had better luck this year."<ref name="dec97bio" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
